summary_1line: Arjuna and Bhima die after ignoring a Yaksha’s warning at a lake; Yudhishthira arrives, mourns, and begins answering the Yaksha’s philosophical riddles.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira stands in grief beside the lake as the bodies of Bhima, Arjuna, Nakula, and Sahadeva lie motionless on the ground among lotuses.
A gigantic radiant Yaksha with fiery eyes perches on a tree above the lake, confronting Yudhishthira as the silent forest surrounds them.
Arjuna, desperate with thirst, shoots arrows into the sky at the unseen voice before drinking from the lake and collapsing lifeless.
